scoring_justification: Recompute infeasible: only final aggregated results output, no raw atomistic data. Compares reported values to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported dislocation energies, slopes, and core radius as reference gold
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table I and text of MRS Proc. 141-317
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper; confirmed by reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's published table and explicit statements; they are the authoritative reference for this computational workflow.

outputs.description: Single JSON file containing all required dislocation energies, slopes, and core radius computed from the atomistic simulations.

output_contract.notes: All energy and slope fields are in eV/Å; core radius in Å. The output contains only public structural information with no gold values.
